description: Nx group for repositories that use Nx

packageRules.description: Nx packages must share one version: update together (majors included), run the Nx migrations manually
prBodyNotes: Nx may ship migrations for this update. On this branch run `pnpm nx migrate <new version> --from=nx@<old version>`, then `pnpm nx migrate --run-migrations` if it created `migrations.json`. Commit the changes and delete `migrations.json`.
